blurb: Oxygen Yoga & Fitness offers over 16 class styles including yoga, pilates, barre, strength, sculpt, and recovery. They use far infrared heat which penetrates deeply to warm the body from the inside out, providing detoxification, pain relief, improved circulation, weight loss, stress reduction, skin purification, enhanced immunity, and relaxation. Classes are designed for all experience levels with certified instructors providing modifications and progressions.
extraNote: Cancel reservations at least 4 hours before class start to avoid late/no-show fees · Autopay membership cancellations require 30 days notice unless medical note provided · Prepaid memberships are non-refundable; medical notes may allow holds · No entry to classes after start time; arrive 15 minutes early
